lines.japanese: 「というわけで！　タマちゃん、私がんばるよ！　がんばってばりばり勉強する！」
lines.english: “And that settles it! Tama, I’m going to do my best! I’m going to hit these books like my life depends on it!”

lines.japanese: 「大量の参考書積んじゃって、今度はなに突然」
lines.english: “What’s with the mountain of study guides? Where did this come from?”

lines.japanese: 「延長戦だよ、延長戦！」
lines.english: “Overtime! We’re going into overtime!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Uh-huh.”

lines.japanese: そうです。そうなのです。
lines.english: That was right. It was true.

lines.japanese: 林田美咲のプレリュードはまだ終わりじゃなかったのです。
lines.english: Misaki Hayashida’s prelude had not ended yet.

lines.japanese: いえ、終わりになんか、させないのです！
lines.english: No, I would never allow it to end!

lines.japanese: 「ギョイィィィ～ン！　ファック・モーニン、２年Ｂ組こと腐れ豚小屋の鎖に繋がれたゾンビ共ォ！　今日も元気に飼いならされてるか～い、ジャカジャカジャカジャカ……！」
lines.english: “Gyeeeooow! Fuck morning, you zombies chained inside the rotten pigsty known as Class 2-B! Are we all bright-eyed and nicely domesticated today? Chaka-chaka-chaka-chaka...!”

lines.japanese: 「佐久間君うるさい」
lines.english: “Sakuma, you’re too loud.”

lines.japanese: 「で、ごめんリンダ、なんだって？」
lines.english: “Anyway, sorry, Linda. What were you saying?”

lines.japanese: 「だからね、私は今日大いなる一歩を踏みだしたけど、それは逆に言えば、遥かなる旅路の始まりでもあるんだよ」
lines.english: “I’m saying that I took a great step forward today, but viewed another way, it was only the beginning of a long, long journey.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Uh-huh.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、抽象表現は後でいいから、とりあえず普通に喋って」
lines.english: “Could you save the abstract metaphors for later and speak normally for now?”

lines.japanese: 「だって、先輩はもうすぐ卒業しちゃうんだよ！？　遥かなる旅路を追いかけてゆくには、先輩と同じ大学へ進むしかないの！」
lines.english: “Haneda is graduating soon! If I want to follow him on that long, long journey, I have to enter the same university!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そういうこと。いつもながら極端だね、リンダは」
lines.english: “Oh, that’s what you meant. Extreme as ever, Linda.”

lines.japanese: 「むん！　恋する乙女はいつだって極端で猪突猛進なのだ」
lines.english: “Hmph! A maiden in love is always extreme and charging blindly forward.”

lines.japanese: 「ふうん。ま、理由はどうあれ、勉強するのはいいことだよね」
lines.english: “Right. Well, whatever your reason, studying is a good thing.”

lines.japanese: 「タマちゃんも応援してくれるんだ！　ありがとう、私がんばる！」
lines.english: “You’re going to support me too? Thank you, Tama! I’ll do my best!”

lines.japanese: 「アァァ──オ！　がんばれがんばれーい、ギャギャギャギャーン！　で、なんの話？」
lines.english: “Aaaah—ow! Do your best, do your best! Gya-gya-gya-gyaaaang! So, what’re we talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「佐久間君！　いますぐ先輩の進学先、第一志望から第七志望まで聞いてきて！」
lines.english: “Sakuma! Go ask Haneda about all seven of his university choices, right now!”

lines.japanese: 「ファ？　アニキ？　あのひとなら受験はやめたって言ってたけど」
lines.english: “Wha? Bro? He said he quit the whole entrance-exam thing.”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、詳しくは教えてくんなかったけど、なんか病気治すンで長期療養するとか何とか」
lines.english: “Wouldn’t give me the details, but something about taking a long time off to get some illness treated.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　えっ？」
lines.english: “What? What?”

lines.japanese: 「柳木原離れて、遠くの病院行くって言ってたかなァ」
lines.english: “Think he said he was leaving Yanagihara for some hospital far away.”

lines.japanese: 「えええっ！？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 衝撃の事実が次々に飛びこんできて、頭が真っ白になりました。
lines.english: One shocking fact after another flew at me, leaving my mind utterly blank.

lines.japanese: え、え？　あの、長期療養って──
lines.english: Wh-what? Long-term treatment meant—

lines.japanese: ──ええっ！？　羽田先輩ったら、そんな重いご病気を抱えていらしたんですか！
lines.english: —what?! Had Haneda been suffering from such a grave illness all this time?

lines.japanese: そ、そんな……どうしよう、まさか先輩が薄幸の美少年だったなんて、なんとお可哀想な……あわわ、私に何か出来ることは……。
lines.english: N-no... What would I do? To think he was a beautiful young man cursed by tragic health! How terribly sad... Oh, no, was there anything I could do for him...?

lines.japanese: はっ！　そうだ、佐久間君にもっと詳しい話を──
lines.english: Oh! Of course! I had to ask Sakuma for more details—

lines.japanese: 「おっと、そうだ、そんなことより聴いてくれよタマチャン。今日はあんたのテーマソングを作ってきてやったぜェ！」
lines.english: “Oh, right! More importantly, listen up, Tama! I wrote your theme song today!”

lines.japanese: 「ワ～ンツスッホ！　♪玉玉玉玉、玉が好きィ～、アタイは玉好き玉泉～！　棒よりむしろ玉が好きィ～（Ｗａｏ！）右と左の玉が好きィ～……」
lines.english: “One-two-three-four! ♪ Balls, balls, balls, balls, I love balls! Tamaizumi’s nuts for balls! I’d rather have the balls than the shaft! (Whoa!) I love the left ball and the right...”

lines.japanese: 「リンダ……君、そんな基本的なことも調べないで追いかけるつもりだったの？」
lines.english: “Linda... You were going to follow him without researching something that basic?”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だって……先輩、進学クラスにいるから進学するものとばっかり……」
lines.english: “B-but... He’s in the university-track class, so I assumed he was going to university...”

lines.japanese: ああ、呑気にこんなことをしてる場合ではありません。
lines.english: Oh, this was no time to be carrying on so carelessly.

lines.japanese: 陰ながら先輩の支えになれるような道を目指さなくては──
lines.english: I had to find a path that would allow me to support Haneda from the shadows—

lines.japanese: 「──どうしようタマちゃん、私せっかく勉強したのが無駄になっちゃった」
lines.english: “—what do I do, Tama? All that studying I did has gone to waste.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね、始めて五分も経ってないけどね」
lines.english: “Right. You haven’t even been at it five minutes.”

lines.japanese: 「ようし、こうなったら！」
lines.english: “All right, then!”

lines.japanese: 「こうなったら？」
lines.english: “Then?”

lines.japanese: 「看護師さんになって、先輩の行く病院に勤めてやる！」
lines.english: “I’ll become a nurse and get a job at Haneda’s hospital!”

lines.japanese: 「間に合わないと思うよ」
lines.english: “I don’t think you’ll make it in time.”

lines.japanese: こうして私の恋は、三歩進んで二歩下がったりしながら、ゆっくりと動きはじめたのです。
lines.english: And so my love slowly began to move, taking three steps forward and two steps back.

lines.japanese: あまりにゆっくり過ぎて先々までは見通せないのですが、なんやかんや不撓不屈の精神でしがみついて行くつもりです。
lines.english: It moved so slowly that I could see nothing of the road ahead, but I intended to cling to it through thick and thin with an indomitable spirit.

lines.japanese: ちなみに看護学校への道もちょっと目指しかけたのですが、進路指導の先生にその筋の参考書を見せていただいたところ思いのほか難解だったので、とりあえず白紙に戻しました。
lines.english: For the record, I did briefly consider nursing school. But when the career counselor showed me the relevant study guides, they proved unexpectedly difficult, so I returned that plan to the drawing board.

lines.japanese: なにか他の手段で先輩のお力になれればと模索中です。
lines.english: At present, I am searching for some other way to be of help to Haneda.

lines.japanese: ともあれこれからも私は、親友のタマちゃんとふたり、二人三脚でがんばって行こうと思います。
lines.english: Whatever happens, I intend to keep doing my best from here on out, side by side with my best friend Tama.

lines.japanese: 「……私、関係なくね？」
lines.english: “...How is any of this my problem?”

lines.japanese: 「そぉーんな、照れるなよう親友～」
lines.english: “Oh, don’t be shy, best friend!”
